AI_AGENTS.TITLE: AI Agents
AI_AGENTS.SUBTITLE: Configure account text agents and their inboxes.

AI_AGENTS.PROMPT_FORMAT_HELP: Line breaks are preserved. Use this space for the assistant's identity, goals, and boundaries.
AI_AGENTS.CONTEXT_MESSAGES_LIMIT_HELP: Defines how many recent messages from this conversation are sent to the AI as context.

AI_AGENTS.SPLIT_RESPONSE_MESSAGES_HELP: When enabled, each paragraph of the AI response is sent as a separate message.
AI_AGENTS.INBOX_HELP: Each inbox can have at most one active text agent.
AI_AGENTS.CONNECTIONS_NOTICE: This assistant uses only the resources linked here.
AI_AGENTS.TOOLS_HELP: Allow the assistant to use these configured tools.
AI_AGENTS.KNOWLEDGE_HELP: Give the assistant selected knowledge sources as context.

AI_AGENTS.CUSTOMER_MEMORY_HELP: Keep a short, private summary of durable customer context for this agent. Disabled by default.
AI_AGENTS.AUDIO_ENABLED_HELP: Allows this assistant to transcribe and understand received voice messages.
AI_AGENTS.ATTACHMENT_INTERPRETATION_ENABLED_HELP: Allows this assistant to read images, PDFs, text files, DOCX and XLSX attachments sent in the conversation.
AI_AGENTS.OCCUPIED: Already linked to an active agent
